items.label: POP QUIZ
items.problem: its header says 3,584 bytes and the block holds 512
items.why: the boot program in the KERNAL format: Novaload, which points the LOAD vector at $0330 to its own routine at $033C and loads the rest of the tape with it (orientation.md, The loader)

items.label: pulses 61715-1530679
items.problem: 1,468,965 pulses in a format the kit does not decode, most of them 312 or 712 cycles long
items.why: 26 files in Novaload format, read by work/novaload.py with every checksum right (orientation.md, table of files): the loader second stage NOVA and the loading picture 0, which the game loads over; the program 3, 4, 1 and 2, the part title, equal to its listing; and five question blocks of four files each (FX, then three), which load into the quiz part ($4F00-$53FF and $B800-$FEFF); block 1 is the quiz listing, and the questions page reads all five
